safetyRules.name: Fruity WaveShaper Safety Rules
safetyRules.description: Critical safety rules for preventing distortion disasters

rules.rule: Always compensate Post gain for Pre gain increases
rules.explanation: Input drive increases output level; compensation prevents clipping
rules.example: If Pre = +12dB, set Post to -8 to -10dB

rules.rule: Monitor channel meter after WaveShaper
rules.explanation: Visual feedback confirms gain staging is correct
rules.action: Watch for red indicators on channel and master meters

rules.rule: Leave Center enabled at all times
rules.explanation: DC offset removal prevents cumulative low-frequency buildup
rules.exception: Only disable for specific experimental sound design
rules.consequence: Headroom loss, speaker damage, muddy low-end

rules.rule: Match processed/unprocessed levels for A/B comparison
rules.explanation: Fair comparison requires equal loudness
rules.method: Adjust Post gain until perceived loudness matches bypassed
rules.consequence: Preference for louder option (not necessarily better)

rules.rule: Use minimum 4x oversampling for hard clipping
rules.explanation: Hard clipping generates high frequencies that alias without oversampling
rules.threshold: Apply when Pre > +10dB or curve has sharp corners

rules.rule: Use 8x-16x oversampling for bitcrushing effects
rules.explanation: Stepped curves create extreme aliasing

rules.rule: Use 4x oversampling for high-frequency sources
rules.explanation: Sources > 5kHz are more prone to audible aliasing

rules.rule: Balance oversampling with CPU usage
rules.explanation: Higher oversampling = higher CPU load
rules.guideline: Use 2x-4x for most instances, 8x-16x only for critical tracks

rules.rule: Use Unipolar for low-end sources (808s, bass, kicks)
rules.explanation: Even harmonics preserve low-end warmth and punch
rules.rationale: Odd harmonics can cause phase issues and mud in lows
rules.consequence: Weak or muddy low-end, loss of sub impact

rules.rule: Use conservative Mix settings with Bipolar mode
rules.explanation: Bipolar generates more aggressive harmonics
rules.guideline: Keep Mix at 30-50% for Bipolar unless full distortion effect desired
rules.consequence: Harshness, listener fatigue, difficult to mix

rules.rule: Start with Unipolar for mix bus applications
rules.explanation: Even harmonics are safer for full mix processing
rules.rationale: Bipolar on mix bus can create cumulative harshness

rules.rule: Match mode to distortion intensity
rules.explanation: Aggressive distortion in Bipolar = very aggressive sound
rules.guideline: Subtle saturation = Unipolar; Heavy crunch = Bipolar

rules.rule: Ensure curve passes through (0,0)
rules.explanation: Unity gain at zero prevents signal cancellation
rules.check: Verify graph shows diagonal through center point
rules.consequence: Signal attenuation or cancellation at low levels

rules.rule: Avoid completely flat sections at extremes
rules.explanation: Flat line = no signal; kills negative or positive half
rules.check: Maintain minimum -0.8 to -1.0 and +0.8 to +1.0 range
rules.consequence: Missing half of waveform, severe distortion

rules.rule: Round sharp corners for musical results
rules.explanation: Sharp corners generate high-frequency harshness
rules.technique: Use spline smoothing, add intermediate points

rules.rule: Test extreme curves with sine waves
rules.explanation: Pure tones reveal curve behavior clearly
rules.method: Apply WaveShaper to 1kHz sine, analyze output spectrum

rules.rule: Never hard-clip 808s at high mix percentages
rules.explanation: Hard clipping removes low-end punch and creates mud
rules.consequence: Weak 808s, lost sub impact, muddy mix

rules.rule: De-ess vocals BEFORE WaveShaper
rules.explanation: Distortion amplifies sibilance

rules.rule: Keep vocal Mix at 35% or below
rules.explanation: Vocals need intelligibility; heavy distortion conflicts

rules.rule: Use parallel processing instead of mix bus distortion
rules.explanation: Cumulative distortion across many tracks = harsh mix
rules.technique: Create dedicated distortion bus, blend to taste

rules.rule: Mono low frequencies before distortion
rules.explanation: Stereo distortion of low frequencies = phase issues
rules.method: Use stereo separation plugin or mono compatibility check
rules.consequence: Phase cancellation, weak bass on mono systems

emergencyProcedures.silence: Check curve passes through (0,0); redraw if needed
emergencyProcedures.harshness: Enable 4x+ oversampling, switch to Unipolar, reduce Mix
emergencyProcedures.lostLowEnd: Enable Center, reduce Pre gain, use Unipolar

symptomSolutions.name: Fruity WaveShaper Symptom-Solution Mapping
symptomSolutions.description: Decision tree for solving common distortion problems

symptoms.symptom: 808s or bass sound weak after WaveShaper

solutions.action: Use soft S-curve instead of hard clip

symptoms.prevention: Always use Unipolar for 808s unless intentional effect

symptoms.symptom: Sound is harsh, grating, or fatiguing
symptoms.prevention: Use minimum 4x oversampling for any noticeable distortion

solutions.reason: Less aggressive curves generate fewer artifacts
Even harmonics less prone to aliasing

symptoms.prevention: Test with sine waves to identify aliasing before mixing

solutions.action: Increase Pre gain to +10dB or higher

symptoms.prevention: Start with moderate Pre gain (+8dB) and adjust to taste

symptoms.symptom: Audio disappears or becomes very quiet
causes: Curve has flat section at bottom

solutions.reason: Center point must maintain unity gain

solutions.action: Verify output range covers -0.8 to +0.8 minimum
solutions.reason: Extreme clipping kills half the signal

symptoms.prevention: Always verify curve passes through center before finalizing

symptoms.symptom: Vocals become too sibilant after WaveShaper
causes: High Pre gain on vocal track

solutions.reason: Remove sibilance before distortion amplifies it
Even harmonics less aggressive on transients

symptoms.prevention: Always de-ess vocals before applying distortion

symptoms.symptom: Drums lose punch and sound mushy
symptoms.prevention: Use Bipolar mode for drum transients and punch

symptoms.symptom: FL Studio lagging or audio dropouts
causes: Too many instances with high oversampling

solutions.action: Reduce oversampling to 2x-4x on non-critical tracks

symptoms.prevention: Use 4x as default; reserve 8x-16x for critical tracks only
